decision_rule.A_T0_INFORMATION: any variable meaningful for C1 at e=0 (ALIVE)
decision_rule.B_EARLY_POST_ENTRY_INFORMATION: at some e <= 120 s, some variable meaningful for C1 in EARLY, AND < 25% of eventual +2A trades alive at e already have MFE >= 1A
decision_rule.C2_reported_separately: answers whether givebacks are distinguishable before +2A (meaningful C2 in PRE2 at a checkpoint or at +0.5/+1/+1.5 first touch)
decision_rule.C_LATE_CONFIRMATION_ONLY: meaningful C1 separation exists (any checkpoint/subset or event-anchored at +1A/+1.5A) but B's conditions are not met

effect_sizes: AUC as probability of superiority (positive group > negative, ties 1/2) with session-block bootstrap 95% CI (1000 reps, seed 20260925); Cohen's d; per-group median and IQR
initial_states: exact 16-state mtf (dir_1m/5m/15m/1h at T0); min support 150 development trades; long vs short compared
meaningful_separation: AUC >= 0.60 with CI lower >= 0.55 (or AUC <= 0.40 with CI upper <= 0.45)
mtf_timing: first INTO-alignment 5m transition vs first-touch times of +0.5/+1/+1.5/+2/+3A (touch before terminal); categories by the highest level touched at or before the transition; 15m/1h repeated
old_buckets: not used for any choice; not shown
population: 2023 development sessions only (6,024 audited T0 trades); final 20% and 2024-2026 never loaded

subsets.EARLY: ALIVE and running MFE < 1A (before substantial excursion)

zero_denominator: fav_share = MFE/(MFE+MAE), 0.5 when both are 0; rates are per minute, 0 at e=0
